Pathweft selective search integration

EverythingToolbar source: a4379f181ea8e9b4d3ff8b0e5178d8d39491830c
https://github.com/srwi/EverythingToolbar/blob/a4379f181ea8e9b4d3ff8b0e5178d8d39491830c/EverythingToolbar.Platform/Search/EverythingIpcClient.cs
Adapted: serialized pending queries, cancellation, unique reply IDs,
asynchronous WM_COPYDATA replies, indexed result metadata and sorting.
Pathweft uses a dedicated STA dispatcher and WPF HwndSource, omits NLog,
CsWin32, highlighted fields, synchronous UI calls and donor product services.

Everything64.dll, 91304 bytes, no file-version resource
DLL SHA256 81B5BE18126ACD2C2B913F8F4A821E476B18393CDD3DEBD03387C50AFD8DB88F
SDK API version 2; default-instance IPC; minimum engine 1.4.1.
The indexer is external, reused, and never started/reconfigured by Pathweft.
